free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0: 100 calls a month, live news 30 minutes late, all sources and 13 languages, HTTPS included; no historical news.
free_tier.notes: A call counts at least 1 request and some options count more. Historical news (the date parameter) needs the Standard plan or higher. The next plan up is Standard at USD 24.99 a month (USD 22.99 billed yearly) for 10,000 calls a month. One API access key per account.

per_object_cap.stated: up to 100 results a call (limit maximum 100, default 25)

retention.stated: live news only, 30 minutes late on the free plan; no historical news

interface_detail: REST over HTTP or HTTPS at api.mediastack.com/v1 (news and sources endpoints); the key goes in the access_key parameter
chaining: 100 calls a month at up to 100 articles a call is a sampling budget, not a feed.

limits.value: 100 calls a month on the free plan
unverified: a per-second or per-minute rate limit answers rate_limit_reached (HTTP 429 in the vendor's suite error table); its size is not published and needs a free key to measure (behind a sign-up)

binding_note: 100 calls a month is met first; the size of the shorter rate limit is not published.

identity_cost.detail: The free sign-up form asks for a first and last name, an email and a password, and billing details: an address, a postal code, a country and a city (state optional). The free form shows no card field.

reliability_note: An account over its monthly volume answers usage_limit_reached and one over the rate limit answers rate_limit_reached; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 missing_access_key.
confidence_note: Quota, delay, page size and sign-up fields are read from first-party pages; a keyless call answered HTTP 401, so the free key was not exercised. The rate limit size and the free-plan answer at 100 calls are unverified: behind a sign-up.
